subject: AWS CPPO: field ops readout & reseller schedule
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudresell.co>, AWS CPPO Team <aws-cp-team@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: AWS CPPO: field ops readout & reseller schedule

Hi Liam / AWS team —

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. As discussed, we want to lock the field ops and PO handoff schedule so CloudResell can hit the May customer onboarding. Attaching a draft scope (CPPO-SOW-v1.pdf) and a proposed reseller activation timeline.

Ask: can you confirm the following by EOD Monday?
- CloudResell quota allocation window (we proposed 5/10–5/24 for subscription entitlements)
- Any metadata AWS needs on our SKU mapping before private offer creation
- Preferred DocuSign flow (AWS-initiated vs partner-initiated)

High level timeline we’re targeting (updated):
- 5/05: final SOW & pricing ack from CloudResell
- 5/10: AWS creates CPPO and shares link with reseller + buyer
- 5/12: Buyer (Acme) submits PO to reseller; reseller forwards to Redwood for verification
- 5/18: Entitlements provisioned; test purchase validated

Ben / Vanessa — FYI. If legal needs to pre-seed any redlines for the DocuSign envelope, flag them here.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Channel Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: CPPO-SOW-v1.pdf (application/pdf), reseller-activation-timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudresell.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS CPPO Team <aws-cp-team@amazon.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 May 2026 11:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AWS CPPO: field ops readout & reseller schedule

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear timeline. We can accommodate the proposed schedule but need one tweak: our reseller billing cycle closes on 5/11, so if the CPPO link is issued after 5/10 we risk the order not hitting the May invoice. Suggested change: AWS creates the CPPO by 5/08 and we route the buyer PO to us by 5/11. That preserves our invoice cut and avoids manual adjustments.

On the metadata: we need the SKU -> CPPO SKU mapping (column A/B) + product descriptor (small paragraph) before CPPO creation. I can take that spreadsheet format and populate it; if you can send the SKU list by EOD Tuesday we’ll prepare the mapping.

DocuSign: partner-initiated is fine as long as AWS accepts the envelope ID for settlement. If AWS wants to kick off the envelope we’re also okay — either way we’ll circulate the final link to Acme.

We’ll confirm quota window once we see the SKU mapping.

—Liam
Head of Partnerships
CloudResell Co.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudresell.co>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS CPPO: field ops readout & reseller schedule

Karthik / team — quick operational notes from my side: 

1) Pricing confirmation — the mark-to-list pricing we proposed in the SOW is good for 30 days; if reseller needs a longer priced window we should capture that in the CPPO notes. CloudResell, if you need a 60-day hold let us know and we’ll set expectations with finance.

2) PO flow — to avoid manual routing, ask that Acme send the PO to procurement@acme.com (their procurement alias) and cc cloudresell accounting@cloudresell.co and procurement@redwood.com. We’ll then validate entitlement against the CPPO link and raise any mismatches.

3) Test purchase — schedule a low-dollar test SKU purchase the week of 5/12 (recommended 5/13) so we can validate entitlement assignment, billing SKU mapping, and usage metering. Monica can run the test and capture logs.

Vanessa — can you confirm if Redwood legal needs to pre-insert any DocuSign language about data handling in the CPPO envelope (we have a standard clause but reseller asked for an explicit data-processing note)?

Ben
Head of Marketplace Ops
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments referenced: acme-procurement-PO-template.docx (word/document)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudresell.co>
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS CPPO: field ops readout & reseller schedule

Ben / Karthik —

Quick legal note: we reviewed the SOW and the standard CPPO envelope language. Two asks before we sign off: 

- Add explicit data processing and retention clause for CPPO purchases (one sentence): "Customer usage data generated through marketplace purchases will be used solely for billing, entitlement verification, and support, and retained for up to 12 months unless otherwise contracted."
- Include a reseller acknowledgement checkbox in the DocuSign flow that confirms reseller will route the buyer PO to Redwood procurement for verification.

If CloudResell agrees to those two items, legal signs off on our side and we can proceed with partner-initiated DocuSign on 5/08. If they want alternative phrasing, please escalate asap.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudresell.co>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, AWS CPPO Team <aws-cp-team@amazon.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 06 May 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS CPPO: field ops readout & reseller schedule

All — thanks for the quick turn. Summary and action items (owner / due):

1) SKU list from Redwood -> CloudResell (Karthik) / due 2026-05-05 EOD (I will drop the SKU export to the Drive folder tonight)
2) CloudResell prepares SKU->CPPO mapping and confirms quota window (Liam) / due 2026-05-07
3) Redwood legal language insertion and DocuSign checkbox (Vanessa) / due 2026-05-07 morning (Vanessa: thanks — text below accepted?)
   - "Customer usage data generated through marketplace purchases will be used solely for billing, entitlement verification, and support, and retained for up to 12 months unless otherwise contracted."
4) Partner-initiated DocuSign creation and CPPO issuance (CloudResell) / target 2026-05-08
5) Test purchase by Acme and validation (Monica) / target 2026-05-13
6) Entitlement go-live and monitoring (Ben / AWS) / target 2026-05-18

Liam — if the earlier CPPO creation (5/08 vs 5/10) helps your invoice cut, please proceed. We’ll aim to have the DocuSign envelope ready for you to send to Acme.

Thanks everyone — I’ll post the SKU export in the Drive folder and update the HubSpot deal with these milestones.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Channel Sales
Redwood Inference
